saml.title: SAML 2.0 providers
saml.description: SAML is configured with SAML_PROVIDERS and SAML_<NAME>_ variables. Every provider validates the signed assertion, audience, recipient and time window, and rejects replays.
saml.configErrors: The SAML configuration has errors that must be fixed in the environment:
saml.empty: No SAML providers are configured. Set SAML_PROVIDERS and the corresponding variables.
saml.autoProvisionOff: Off – the user must exist in advance
saml.idpInitiatedOn: IdP-initiated sign-in is allowed; replay and signature checks remain active.
saml.help: Metadata is published at /api/auth/saml/<slug>/metadata. See docs/OPERATIONS.md and docs/manual/en/30-administrator.md. Changes require an app restart.

fieldPolicy.title: Field-level RBAC
fieldPolicy.description: Sensitive fields are masked on the server before data reaches the API, search, exports or the UI. The matrix below is the role default.
fieldPolicy.note: ADMIN and OFFICE keep today's access. Technicians see their own payroll and expense amounts, but not customer contact details or invoice amounts. The customer portal sees only its own data.
fieldPolicy.overrideNote: An administrator can grant a single field explicitly with the key fields.<group> in the user's permissions. The key can only widen access, never grant ADMIN.
